description:
Aggregate the work that delivers this outcome: well-known files, schema paths and reserved targets go through VirtualPath, and ProfileId lives in the domain.

## Background

This story groups the tasks of epic 2195c98f that share one design surface, so they can be reviewed together once each has landed.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Well-known `.jit` files and schema paths come only from `VirtualPath` constants and constructors.
- [hard] REQ-02: Reserved application targets are recognised by one `VirtualPath` predicate after classification.
- [hard] REQ-03: `ProfileId` is a domain type, and profile dependency resolution compares `ProfileId` values.
title: Repository paths and profile identity are typed
